briefdescription.para: A stat_foreach() callback used to handle access to e.g.
Push a table with a network metric to a Lua stack.

detaileddescription.para: Expects one argument with a name of a needed metric. The pushed table contains some subset of 'total', 'rps', 'current' fields.
Metrics are the same as in lbox_stat_net_call().

briefdescription.para: Push a table of network metrics to a Lua stack.

detaileddescription.para: These fields have the following meaning:

listitem.para: total amount of events since start;
rps amount of events per second, mean over last 5 seconds;
current amount of resources currently hold (say, number of open connections).
